description: LTE-V2X Wyoming Connected Vehicle Pilot test ID WV2IMCT-1 BSM count is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. Part of the Wyoming Department of Transportation Connected Vehicle Pilot Phase 4. Verify that OBUs use different LTE-V2X Configuration Profiles based on the vehicle's speed. Host and remote vehicles travelling below 120 kmph Host and remote vehicles travelling above 120 kmph. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 6 columns, among them repetition, duration, end_time_UTC, start_time_UTC, BSM_record_count_transmitted_and_received, test_speed. The portal shows 2024-07-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
